pages: GENService Access For the GENService module and questions pertaining to GENService, you will need access to GENService. If you have proper access to GENService, you’re good-to-go and no further action is necessary. If you’re not familiar with GENService, you will need to become familiar and obtain a login prior to attempting the GENService module. GENService is a service portal where we communicate to you, the technician. If you are an Office Administrator, Sales Associate or Service Technician, you need to obtain your login from your admin, proprietor, company principal, manager, or owner of your company and not Generac. We only provide one login. If you’re the proprietor, company principal, manager, or owner; a GENService login is provided to you by Generac. All certified technicians are required to have access to GENService as per your contractual agreement with Generac. 11/16/2021
